title: Dren Bio lands $350M to push rare blood cancer therapy toward market
snippet: After Sanofi paid $600 million in cash to acquire Dren Bio’s bispecific last year, the biotech has secured a hefty financing to fund late-stage development and commercial preparations for its lead asset.

title: Lilly’s guidance has jumped by $10B as GLP-1 sales keep blowing past expectations
snippet: With the commercial business performing so well, Eli Lilly is eyeing earlier business development bets to build out a longer-term pipeline.

title: Merck looks ahead to ‘another year of investment’ as Keytruda cliff looms
snippet: On its third-quarter earnings investor call Thursday morning, Merck executives touted recent pipeline wins alongside a strong performance for subcutaneous Keytruda and pulmonary arterial hypertension drug Winrevair that drove the pharma’s overall sales expectations to surpass expectations.

title: BMS drops Prothena-partnered neuro drug, sales outlook improves on a Q3 beat
snippet: In addition to canning an Orum-acquired blood cancer candidate last month, Bristol Myers Squibb cut a Prothena-partnered neuro asset in the third quarter. But with sales climbing 7%, the Big Pharma raised its full-year revenue forecast.

title: Ono cans 2 endocannabinoid drug studies after quintuple Phase 2 failure
snippet: Ono Pharma’s ONO-1110 failed five Phase 2 trials, leading to the discontinuation of development in depression and social anxiety. Work will continue for three pain indications.

title: Lilly can’t stop, won’t stop as revenue climbs 39% thanks to GLP-1 bestsellers
snippet: Eli Lilly’s shares rose 4% in early morning trading after reporting revenue of $24.4 billion, well past consensus estimates.

title: HHS clears compounding pharmacies to manufacture 6 unapproved peptides
snippet: Under the interim policy, officials do not intend to take action against sites that produce the peptides.

title: Biopharma cuts at manufacturing plants expected to affect 4,000+
snippet: As companies invest billions of dollars to reshore manufacturing, 10 biotech and pharma businesses are reportedly trimming staff at manufacturing locations in 2026 or the coming years, with BioNTech having the deepest cuts.

title: 8 companies hiring in New York
snippet: Looking for a biopharma job in New York? Jobs on BioSpace have soared year over year and month over month.
